Edge list of a discovery result

Source: R/cd-result.R
cd_edges.Rd

Returns the edges of a cd_result (or a bare adjacency matrix) as a data frame, one row per edge, with the orientation made explicit.

Usage

cd_edges(x, agreement = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A cd_result or a square adjacency matrix in amat.cpdag convention.

agreement

A single logical. When TRUE and x is a consensus cd_result carrying per-edge agreement (from cd_auto() with mode = "consensus"), an agreement column reports the share of the combined methods that found each edge. NA where no agreement is recorded.

Value

A data frame with columns from, to, and type ("-->" for a directed edge, "---" for an undirected one), and – when agreement = TRUE – an agreement column. Zero rows when the graph is empty.

See also

Other results: cd_result()

Examples

g <- matrix(c(0, 0, 1, 0), 2, 2,
            dimnames = list(c("x1", "x2"), c("x1", "x2")))
cd_edges(cd_result(graph = g, method = "demo"))
#>   from to type
#> 1   x1 x2  -->
